summary: Iteration 4 frontend-only verification of strategist-as-main-character flow on the Freudenberg draft (01054c5e-1b45-4801-8172-6089d23a89b8) and Founder room illustrative scenario. Each run card exposes run-received-* summary with the actual input (received pre lengths 2371/2371/8000 chars, all start with '=== RECORD (draft) ==='). Manual editor edit + save-version-btn -> v3 saved with source='user'; reload shows text persists. critical_code_review_comments: ContentDesk.jsx MyDecision statusMap (line 139) couples the strategist's final-decision wording to draft status strings. If DECISIONS labels are renamed in future, status will silently become undefined. Consider defining the mapping as a constant beside DECISIONS and asserting completeness.

ContentDesk.jsx is 350+ lines mixing AgathaView/BerdineView/SynthesisView/MyDecision/Stages/main component. Extracting MyDecision and the three agent views into /components/contentdesk/*.jsx would make the file easier to maintain and test.

Output.jsx PostChip (line 21) renders the inline button with a hover popover; many chips (98 on this draft) all mount their popover DOM eagerly. Lazy-mount the popover on hover/focus to reduce DOM weight on large drafts.

AgentRunCard.jsx run-received panel always renders the full input pre; for very long inputs it is already capped at max-h-72 with scroll but the raw text (up to 8000 chars) is still shipped in the DOM. Consider truncating with 'show more' for inputs > ~4KB.
